subcategoryTitle: 密碼協定、時間與量測證據

References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.textEn: Two classroom timestamps share a trusted time base and declared accuracy. Subtract latest possible start from earliest possible finish to obtain a defensible minimum separation. Missing accuracy must not be silently interpreted as zero uncertainty.
